findings.title: DUP-CHARGE
findings.statement: The payment step accepts a second submit while the first is still in flight, and charges the card twice.
reproduction: Throttle the connection to Slow 3G in devtools, or test on a real congested mobile network.
Add any plant to the cart and proceed as a guest through shipping.
On the payment step, enter card details in the iframe and press Pay.
Observe: the control gives no pending, disabled, or spinner state while the request is outstanding.
Press Pay again after roughly two seconds of silence — the interval at which users conclude a tap did not register.
Check the payment provider dashboard for two authorizations against the same cart.
findings.impact: A guest is charged twice for one order and has no account, no order history, and no self-serve refund path. The only route back is a support ticket or a card chargeback, both of which cost the user days and cost you the dispute fee and the trust. This is the single failure in the flow that takes real money and cannot be undone by the user. It also directly fails a stated acceptance criterion.
